name: Devadesátky
description: Svoboda! Plakáty z roku 1989, trikolóra, psací stroj a srdíčko. Jednoduché, bez animací rozhraní.
description_en: Freedom! Posters from 1989, the tricolour, a typewriter and a heart. Simple, no UI animations.
author: music-box

effects.name: Trikolóra nahoře
effects.css: body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 8px; z-index: 100; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #ffffff 0 33%, #d7141a 33% 66%, #11457e 66%); }
